falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 77% similarity to bottom_2024_aug assumed that level holds as support, and losing it proves this was not a comparable bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled fear/peak anxiety; a VIX spike above 35 indicates panic escalation rather than blowoff exhaustion, invalidating the 'HOLD' signal which assumed stress was peaking and abating

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield closes above 4.50% on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A yield breakout above 4.50% signals renewed macro stress (inflation/recession fears) that overrides the bottoming pattern; the August 2024 bottom formed as yields stabilized, so this divergence proves the current environment is not analogous

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
